abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is highly resistant to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy due to its highly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME).
METHODS: Key regulatory genes were screened using bioinformatics analysis of TCGA and KEGG datasets. The expression patterns of HK2 were analyzed by single-cell sequencing and immunohistochemistry. The HK2-CCL5-CD8+ T-cell axis was evaluated using mouse pancreatic cancer models, in vitro co-culture systems, Transwell assays, RNA sequencing, and flow cytometry. The relationship between HK2 and anti-PD-1 therapy was also assessed.
RESULTS: Hexokinase 2 (HK2), a rate-limiting enzyme of glycolysis, is a key regulator in tumor immune evasion. HK2 is highly expressed in PDAC tumor cells. Its expression is significantly associated with CD8+ T-cell infiltration in the tumor microenvironment and disease progression. Inhibiting HK2 expression significantly promotes CC motif chemokine ligand 5 (CCL5) secretion by pancreatic cancer cells, which enhances the recruitment of CD8+ T-cell. Moreover, inhibiting HK2 enhance antitumor efficacy of anti-PD-1 therapy in PDAC. Mechanistically, ROS scavenging with NAC reverses the CCL5 upregulation caused by HK2 inhibition, which in turn affects CD8+ T-cell infiltration.
CONCLUSION: Our study reveals a novel HK2-CCL5 axis that regulates CD8+ T-cell recruitment and shapes the immune microenvironment in PDAC.
key_points_ko: HK2는 췌관선암 세포에서 높게 발현되며 종양 미세환경 내 CD8+ T세포 침윤 및 질병 진행과 유의한 연관성을 보였습니다.
HK2를 억제하면 암세포의 CCL5 분비가 촉진되어 CD8+ T세포의 동원이 증가했습니다.
HK2 억제는 전임상 췌장암 모델에서 항 PD-1 치료의 항종양 효과를 증대시켰습니다.
summary_ko: 췌관선암(PDAC)은 면역억제성 종양 미세환경으로 인해 면역관문억제제에 강한 저항성을 보입니다. 본 연구진은 생물정보학 분석과 동물 실험을 통해 해당과정의 핵심 효소인 헥소키나아제 2(HK2)가 면역 회피에 중요한 역할을 한다는 점을 규명했습니다. 연구 결과, 암세포에서 HK2 발현을 억제하면 케모카인 CCL5 분비가 증가하여 CD8+ T세포의 종양 내 유입이 촉진되었습니다. 또한 HK2 억제는 췌장암 모델에서 항 PD-1 면역항암치료의 항종양 효과를 유의하게 향상시켰습니다.
title: Targeted inhibition of HK2 expression in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma reprogrammes the immune microenvironment by regulating CCL5-mediated CD8+ T cell infiltration
title_ko: 췌관선암에서 HK2 발현의 표적 억제를 통한 CCL5 매개 CD8+ T세포 침윤 조절 및 면역 미세환경 재프로그래밍
